cards.front: [Rule 23(1), (2) & (3) | Timeline / Deadline] State the exact claim submission rules and timelines for the Subscriber and CRA Claim ID generation under Rule 23(1)–(3)!
cards.back:
- **Mode of Claim [Rule 23(1)]:** Subscriber has option to submit claim through a mode specified by **PFRDA** from time to time (online or physical).
- **Superannuation Claim Deadline [Rule 23(2)]:** Submit duly filled PFRDA withdrawal form + documents to **HOO**:

cards.front: [Rule 27, Rule 28 + Proviso, Rule 29(1)–(2) & Rule 30 | Authority] State the exact legal provisions on Interpretation [Rule 27], Power to Relax & its Proviso [Rule 28], Residual Matters [Rule 29], and Repeal & Saving [Rule 30].
cards.back:
- **Rule 27 [Interpretation]:** Any doubt on interpretation shall be referred to the Government in the **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions** for decision.
- **Rule 28 [Power to Relax + Proviso]:** Where any Ministry/Department is satisfied that operation of any rule causes **undue hardship in any particular case**, it may, by order **for reasons to be recorded in writing**, dispense with or relax that rule to deal with the case in a just and equitable manner.
  - **PROVISO:** **No such order shall be made EXCEPT with the CONCURRENCE of the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions!**
- **Rule 29 [Residual Matters]:** **(1)** Related issues not specifically covered are decided per **CCS (Pension) Rules, FR, SR, or general/special Govt orders** *(provided not repugnant/inconsistent)*. **(2)** Central Govt may issue orders/instructions for unprovided matters.
- **Rule 30 [Repeal & Saving]:** Prior orders/instructions/OMs cease to operate on matters covered herein; **anything done or action taken** under them is **deemed taken under corresponding provisions** of these rules.

cards.front: [Rules 20–24 + Bhavishya Portal Mandates & Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (Sec. 111) | 2024–2026 Update] How do (a) the mandatory 'Bhavishya' Online Pension/Exit Portal and (b) Section 111 of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), 2023 apply to Central Government NPS Subscribers?
cards.back:
**(a) `Bhavishya` Online Portal & `e-HRMS 2.0 / CRA` Integration [Rules 20–24]:**
- DoPPW mandated **100% electronic processing through `Bhavishya`** (integrated with **PFMS**, **e-HRMS 2.0**, **CPAO**, and **CRA**) for Central Govt retirees.
- Where an NPS subscriber/family avails **OPS Invalid/Disability/Family Pension** [Rules 16(9), 17(1), 20(1)] or **Retirement/Death Gratuity** [Rule 26 / Gratuity Rules], claims are processed online on **Bhavishya** using **integrated Form 6-A** (introduced 16.07.2024) and **e-PPO** is pushed to **DigiLocker**.

**(b) `Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), 2023` — Section 111 *(w.e.f. 01.07.2024, replacing Sec. 108 of Indian Evidence Act, 1872)*:**
- Governs the **7-year statutory presumption of death** for a **missing NPS employee**.
- **Interim Relief (after 6 months from Police FIR):** OPS Family Pension + Retirement Gratuity [DoPPW OM 28.04.2022] OR **20% interim NPS corpus** [PFRDA 16.12.2025 Amendment].
- **Final Settlement (after BSA Sec. 111 7-year presumption / court declaration):** Balance **Death Gratuity minus Retirement Gratuity** (under OPS/Gratuity Rules) OR **remaining 80% NPS corpus** (under PFRDA Exit Regulations) is released!

cards.front: [Form 1 & Form 2 Statutory Footnotes / Instructions | Exam Trap] What are the FIVE granular statutory instructions printed on Form 1 and Form 2 (e.g., Is original Form 2 ever replaced? Which family members are listed? Are judicially separated spouses included?)?
cards.back:
1. **Safe Custody Copy [Form 1 Note]:** Receiving Officer fills acknowledgement & **returns a duly signed copy of complete Form 1 to the Government servant**, who keeps it in safe custody for beneficiaries.
2. **Original Form 2 NEVER Substituted during Service [Form 2 Note 1]:** Original Form 2 is **retained permanently**; **NO new Form will substitute the original Form 2** during service! Additions/alterations are recorded in **Column 7** under HOO's signature. *However, the retiring Subscriber must submit family details afresh at retirement.*
3. **Who Must Be Listed in Form 2 [Note 2]:** Spouse, **ALL children**, and **parents** *(whether currently eligible for family pension or NOT!)*, plus **disabled siblings (brothers & sisters)**.
4. **Remarks Column [Note 3]:** HOO records date of receipt of addition/alteration, disability fact, or change of marital status in the *'Remarks'* column.
5. **Judicially Separated Spouse [Note 4]:** *'Wife'* and *'husband'* **SHALL INCLUDE judicially separated wife and husband**!

⚠️ EXAM TRAP / PROVISO ALERT: Every single one of Notes 1–4 of Form 2 has been asked in SAS/LDCE exams: (1) Original Form 2 is NOT replaced (changes entered in Col. 7); (2) Ineligible children/parents are ALSO listed; (3) Judicially separated wife/husband IS included (divorced spouse is NOT)!

cards.front: [Form 4-C, Form 4-D & Form 4-E [See Rule 24(1)] — Internal Statutory Clauses | Sub-rule / Clause] Detail the exact alternative clauses printed inside the statutory text of Form 4-C, Form 4-D, and Form 4-E under Rule 24(1)!

- Covers **(i)** Penalty of **compulsory retirement / dismissal / removal** [Rule 18] OR **(ii)** **Resignation** accepted w.e.f. `[date]` [Rule 14(1)].

cards.front: [DoPPW O.M. dated 28.04.2022 (Missing NPS Employees) | 2024–2026 Update] How are benefits regulated if a Central Government employee covered under NPS goes MISSING during service (DoPPW O.M. dated 28.04.2022 & PFRDA Dec 2025 Amendment)?
cards.back:
**1. Where Option / Default under Rule 10 is OPS / EOP [DoPPW O.M. dt. 28.04.2022]:**
- Family must lodge an **FIR with the Police** and obtain a police report that employee has not been traced despite all efforts.
- **Family Pension & Retirement Gratuity** sanctioned **after expiry of 6 MONTHS from the date of lodging FIR**.
- **NPS Account Action:** IPA is **NOT closed immediately** — **Govt contribution + returns** transferred to Govt Account, and **Employee share + returns** kept/settled per missing-employee rules; if employee later reappears, adjustments are made *(difference between Death Gratuity and Retirement Gratuity becomes payable only after **7 years** presumption of death under Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 / Indian Evidence Act)*.

**2. Where Option / Default is NPS [PFRDA Amendment Regulations, Dec 2025]:**
- Nominees/legal heirs receive **20% of Accumulated Pension Corpus as interim relief** (after FIR + untraceable report), and the **remaining 80% corpus** is settled after formal presumption of death under the **Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023**!

⚠️ EXAM TRAP / PROVISO ALERT: Notice BOTH rules: 6 months after FIR for OPS family pension + retirement gratuity (DoPPW OM 28.04.2022 & Gratuity Amendment 2025), and 20% interim corpus payout under PFRDA Dec 2025 Regulations if exiting under NPS!

No. 57/06/2021-P&PW(B) dated 14.10.2024 | 2024–2026 Update] What landmark retrospective relief did DoPPW O.M. dated 14.10.2024 grant for pre-31.03.2021 death/invalidation/disability NPS cases (originally settled under OM dated 05.05.2009), including interest rates and Major Heads?
cards.back:
- **Background:** Under old OM dt. **05.05.2009**, when pre-2021 NPS employees/families took provisional OPS/EOP pension on death/disability, **100% of NPS corpus (both Employee + Govt share)** was transferred into Govt Account (`MH 0071`).
- **Retrospective Relief w.e.f. 01.01.2004 [OM dt. 14.10.2024]:** Aligned pre-2021 cases with Rules 16(10), 17(2) & 20(2)!
  1. **ONLY Govt contribution + returns** is retained in Govt Account.
  2. **Employee's contribution + returns thereon SHALL BE REFUNDED** to the Government servant / nominee(s) / legal heir(s), **ALONG WITH INTEREST at PPF deposit rates** from the date of death/boarding out up to the date of payment!
  3. **Reverse Case (Employee kept NPS corpus + also got OPS pension):** Must refund **Govt contribution + returns** along with interest at **GPF rate**!
- **Accounting Heads (C&AG / CGA Procedure):** Transfer Employee share from `MH 0071` to **`MH 8342` (Other Deposits — 117 Defined Contribution Pension Scheme)**; book PPF interest debit to **`MH 2049` (Interest Payments)** and pay out from **`MH 8342`**.

cards.front: [CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Rules, 2021 [G.S.R. 658(E)] + 2025 Amendment [G.S.R. 258(E)] | 2024–2026 Update] Summarize the key exam provisions of the sister 'CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Rules, 2021', the ₹25 Lakh hike, and the 'CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Amendment Rules, 2025' [G.S.R. 258(E) dt. 24.04.2025]!
cards.back:
- **Principal Rules:** Notified **23.09.2021** [G.S.R. 658(E)], giving statutory backing to Retirement & Death Gratuity for NPS subscribers.
- **Qualifying Service & Formula [Rule 22]:** Min **5 years** qualifying service for Retirement Gratuity = **1/4th of emoluments (Basic Pay + NPA + DA) for each completed 6-monthly period**, max **16½ times emoluments**.
- **Death Gratuity Slabs:** `<1 yr` = **2×**; `1 to <5 yrs` = **6×**; `5 to <11 yrs` = **12×**; `11 to <20 yrs` = **20×**; `≥20 yrs` = **½ emoluments per completed 6-monthly period (max 33×)**.

- **2025 Amendment Rules [G.S.R. 258(E) dt. 24.04.2025]:**
  1. Inserted **Rule 4A (Limitation on Gratuity):** No separate gratuity for re-employment period; on joining Govt from AB/PSU with proper permission, Govt pays gratuity only for Govt service (combined cap = total combined service × final Govt emoluments; AB/PSU pays its own share).
  2. **Compulsory Retirement Penalty:** If order on quantum of gratuity is not issued simultaneously, **provisional gratuity @ 2/3rds** of full superannuation gratuity shall be sanctioned.
  3. **AO Emoluments Check:** Accounts Officer verifies correctness of emoluments **only for 24 months preceding retirement**.

cards.front: [PFRDA Partial Withdrawal & Lien Norms (Reg. 8 as amended 16.12.2025) | 2024–2026 Update] What are the LATEST limits, frequency, mandatory year-gaps, loan/lien facility, and permitted vs removed purposes for PARTIAL WITHDRAWAL under PFRDA's 16.12.2025 Amendment Regulations?

  5. **NEW:** **Settlement of financial obligation** taken from a regulated financial institution against lien/charge on NPS account.

Issued by **CPAO (Dept. of Expenditure)** on **19.10.2026** (with **CGA** approval, superseding earlier U.O. dt. **17.09.2025** & CPAO OM dt. **07.10.2025**):

- **One-Time, One-Way Switch Deadlines:** Exercisable anytime during service, **NOT LATER THAN**:
  1. **(a)** **12 months prior** to the date of **superannuation**;
  2. **(b)** **3 months prior** to the deemed date of **voluntary retirement**; OR
  3. **(c)** **At the time of resignation OR non-penal compulsory retirement under FR 56(j)**!
- **Absolute Bars on Switching:** Switch facility **CANNOT** be exercised:
  - Where **departmental or judicial proceedings are pending OR contemplated** against the subscriber; OR
  - In cases of **removal, dismissal, or compulsory retirement as a penalty**.
- **4% Differential Govt Credit Formula:** Under UPS, only `10%` Govt share went to Individual Corpus (and `8.5%` to Pool), whereas NPS gives `14%` to Individual Corpus. On switching back to NPS, the **additional 4% Govt contribution (`14% − 10%`)** for the entire UPS period is **computed on the PFRDA Default Investment Pattern and credited to the Subscriber's NPS Account**, and future Govt contributions resume at **14%**!

cards.front: [DoPPW O.M. Series No. 57/03/2022-P&PW(B)/8361 dated 27.10.2026 | 2024–2026 Update] Summarize the FIVE strict-compliance clarifications issued by DoPPW in its October 27, 2026 O.M. batch (`No. 57/03/2022-P&PW(B)/8361`) harmonizing UPS & NPS establishment administration!
cards.back:
Issued on **27.10.2026** for strict compliance by all Ministries/Departments dealing with **UPS / NPS** matters:
1. **Mandatory Probation Contributions (`Rule 6(6)`):** Establishments **cannot wait for probation confirmation** — 10% employee & matching employer deductions are mandatory throughout probation.
2. **Unpaid Absence (`Rule 6(3)` & `7(1)`):** Zero subscriber contribution during unpaid leave/absence; employer notional contribution restricted strictly to the **3 statutory grounds** (medical ground, civil commotion, useful higher studies).
3. **Delayed Deposit Protection (`Rule 8(1)`):** Where enrollment, salary deduction, or Govt credit is delayed for reasons **not attributable to the subscriber**, administration must restore/compensate delayed credit.
4. **Deputation / Foreign Service Retirement (`Rule 25` equivalent):** Central-to-Central deputation processed by **Borrowing HOO**; State Govt deputation / Foreign Service processed by **Lending HOO / Cadre Authority**.
5. **Pending Proceedings on Retirement (`8361(10)`):** Unconcluded departmental proceedings continue post-retirement as **deemed proceedings under Rule 5 of CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Rules, 2021**; on full exoneration, subscriber gets full notional assured payout; post-retirement arrears on death of subscriber & spouse go to **legal heir(s)**.

  - **Oct 2022 Batch:** `25.10.2022` (Rule 5 Emoluments), `26.10.2022` (Rule 10 Option), `27.10.2022` (Rules 18–19 Disciplinary Proceedings & Gratuity), `28.10.2022` (Rules 16–17 Invalidation/Disablement + Death Gratuity & Rule 20 Death).
  - **Oct 2024 Batch (`8361(1)` to `(9)`):** `07.10.2024` (Rule 6 Employee Share, Rule 7 Govt Share, Rule 15 Absorption), `11.10.2024` (Rule 12 20-Yr VRS, Rule 14 Resignation, Rule 18 Dismissal/Removal), `14.10.2024` (Oversight Portal + Pre-2021 Refund OM), `25.10.2024` (`8361(8)` Autonomous Bodies Exclusion & `8361(9)` Rule 10 Form 1/2 Campaign).
